locations.rationale: Function-pointer argument in Internal::setMgrFn(L, mgr, "bind", hlBind) inside Internal::registerToplevelBindings; the token resolves to the static function hlBind declared at line 132 of the same translation unit.

records.rationale: hlBind is declared as a static (internal-linkage) function at src/config/lua/bindings/LuaBindingsToplevel.cpp line 132, so it is only referable within this translation unit. A repository-wide exact-token search for hlBind returned exactly two occurrences: the declaration token itself (never a usage) and the reference at line 537 (0-indexed 536) where hlBind is passed as the C function registered under the Lua name "bind". No import/export binding tokens exist in C++ for a static function, so under bindings_optional the required set is the single registration-site token. definitionUsage is the sole required location. The line is pure ASCII, so UTF-16 character offsets 39-45 are exact.
